_comment: IDENTITY REGISTRY. Copy to accounts.json and fill in your own identities. Read before ANY outbound communication — sending from the wrong account is unrecoverable.
hard_rules: ALWAYS state which account you are acting as, in plain text, BEFORE drafting.
NEVER send, reply, or create a calendar invite without explicit confirmation of the final text AND the sending account.
If the correct account for a task is NOT connected, STOP and say so. Never substitute a different account.
Match account to context via `routing` below. When context is ambiguous, follow `precedence`.
_precedence_note: Highest-priority account that fits the context wins. `personal` is the general default.

personal.role: your primary address — the default identity
personal.status: Set connected:true after you authorize it (see docs/google-direct-auth.md).
personal.use_for: general correspondence, personal matters, anything without a clear business owner
personal._note: Token stored in ~/.secrets/google/personal.json — never in this repo.

work.status: NOT AUTHORIZED — authorize when you need it.

routing._comment: project name -> account key. If that account isn't connected, STOP; do not downgrade.
